summary.text: Ghost Summoning is Zhang Li's soul path immortal killer move.

claims.text: In a realistic dream realm, Fang Yuan is the female immortal Zhang Li, facing a young rank seven Gu Immortal who shouts that she murdered her own husband. Zhang Li cultivates enchantment emotion path, a tiny path derived from wisdom path. Fang Yuan does not know her immortal killer moves. Under unravel dream, an Immortal Gu and dozens of mortal Gu activate, then a completely unknown immortal killer move fires. He cannot help but pinch his fingers, wave at the young Gu Immortal, and whisper “Ghost summoning.” A ghost with rank seven battle strength flies toward the incoming jade wind dagger. The young Gu Immortal sees it and shouts for his brother. Zhang Li had killed her husband and refined his soul into this move. Fang Yuan tells the attacker that stopping the killer move can save the brother’s soul, then finds a flaw and kills him, passing the dream realm.

His wisdom path and soul path attainment both rise. Enchantment emotion path has never left wisdom path, so there are no enchantment emotion path dao marks, only wisdom path dao marks. He judges that Zhang Li perhaps cultivated soul path too, because this move belongs to soul path. After the dream, his soul path rises to quasi-master. He finds the move interesting. He lacks enough soul path attainment, but his wisdom path is grandmaster, and because the dream was realistic he thinks he can likely use the same killer move again at a portion of its strength, or create a similar one. He still ranks improving vajra shell above replicating it.
